hard_case: a committed snapshot exists and jest.config.js holds only a `projects` array of inline objects; no project moves where snapshots are read, so the committed entry is the oracle (#10139)

truth.toolchain: node 22.22.0; jest 30.5.2, ts-jest 29.4.14, typescript 5.9.3; edit applied by hand and the test command run on the whole package

mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: the edit is the spec's behavior change (140 becomes 130 for amount 150)

reasoning: `priceSnapInline(150)` returns 140; the edit returns 130. `jest.config.js` holds only `projects: [{ displayName: "unit", ... }]`, an inline object that sets no `rootDir`, `roots` or `snapshotResolver`, so the committed entry `priceSnapInline 1` = `140` is read and `npm test` fails the edit. RIPR-SPEC-0258 example 8: a `projects` array of inline objects is read, not refused. ripr reports `exposed`. Before #10139 any `projects` key refused and the test read `weakly_exposed`, a false actionable verdict.
